contentText: Ah, AB Cricinfo , the YouTube channel that delivers red‑hot cricket highlights, sharp analysis, unapologetic opinions, and just enough sarcasm to keep Twitter (sorry, X ) permanently offended. If you’ve ever scrolled through YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels, chances are you’ve stumbled upon a chubby guy passionately ranting about Indian cricket , especially when the topic is India vs Pakistan . That’s where AB Cricinfo truly shifts gears and turns trolling into an art form. But despite millions of views, viral reels, and endless curiosity, one question refuses to die: Who on earth is AB Cricinfo? Let’s break down everything we know, and don’t know about this mysterious cricket creator. The Biggest Question: Who Is AB Cricinfo, Really? For years, AB Cricinfo has deliberately  kept his identity under wraps. Fans constantly ask about his real name, face, background, and personal life, and he consistently dodges it. Is this anonymity accidental? Not at all. Just like Khan Sir , AB Cricinfo believes the spotlight should stay on the content , not the creator. The result? A brilliant branding move that keeps people hooked while allowing him to speak freely without becoming a traditional internet celebrity. Despite heavy speculation, his real name has never been officially revealed . Rumoured Real Names (Unconfirmed) Several online sources speculate that his real name could be: Vikram Singh Abhishek Sharma Sunil Kumar None of these claims have been verified. Our team even attempted to contact him for a podcast interview, but we haven’t received a response yet. If he ever confirms his identity publicly, this section will be updated. Early Life & Background Very little is known about AB Cricinfo’s early life. What is  known is that he reportedly hails from Chandigarh , India. Beyond that, details about his childhood, parents, or siblings remain private. And honestly? That secrecy is part of the charm. Educational Background AB Cricinfo has never publicly disclosed his educational qualifications. However, multiple sources suggest that during the COVID‑19 lockdown, he worked as a video editor at ABP News . Some reports claim he left the job voluntarily, while others suggest layoffs played a role. Either way, that turning point became a blessing in disguise . Career Journey: From ₹4,000 a Month to Millions of Fans AB Cricinfo’s journey is nothing short of inspirational. Before YouTube Before finding success online, he worked multiple jobs, including: Telecaller at Vodafone (formerly Hutch) Car salesman Assistant video editor He later completed a video editing course  and worked with several local news channels , eventually landing a role at ABP News . The YouTube Struggle Success didn’t come overnight. Before AB Cricinfo became a household name among cricket fans, three of his YouTube channels failed . But instead of quitting, he doubled down. Birth of AB Cricinfo His fourth attempt “AB Cricinfo”  finally clicked. His brutally honest takes, emotional delivery, raw desi tone, and fearless criticism (especially of Pakistan cricket) struck a chord with viewers. Today, AB Cricinfo boasts: 1.88+ million YouTube subscribers Massive reach across Instagram, Facebook, X, and WhatsApp Why Fans Love (and Fear) AB Cricinfo AB Cricinfo doesn’t just analyse cricket, he dissects it mercilessly . He has a special brand of sarcastic affection  for certain players, where praise and trolling walk hand in hand. Fans often joke that if AB Cricinfo talks about you, you’ve either made it… or you’re about to be roasted. Players frequently on his radar include: KS Bharat Babar Azam Hardik Pandya Krunal Pandya Ruturaj Gaikwad Vijay Shankar Are they being praised? Mocked? Mentally prepared for destruction? With AB Cricinfo, you never really know — and that unpredictability is the magic. AB Cricinfo Income & Net Worth (2025) With a massive digital footprint, AB Cricinfo earns through: YouTube ads Sponsorships & brand deals Instagram & Facebook collaborations Affiliate marketing Super Chats & paid promotions Estimated Earnings Monthly Income:  ₹4.5 lakh – ₹15 lakh Annual Income:  ₹50 lakh – ₹2 crore Estimated Net Worth (2025):  ₹8–10 crore These figures are approximate and based on publicly available data. Platform‑Wise Earnings Breakdown Platform Followers Monetization Estimated Monthly Earnings YouTube 1.88M Ads, sponsorships, Super Chats ₹3 – ₹10L (can go up to ₹15–20L) Instagram 259K Reels, sponsored posts ₹1 – ₹3L Facebook 197K Ads & brand deals ₹1.5 – ₹4L X (Twitter) 29.2K Paid promos ₹20K – ₹70K WhatsApp Channel 19K Link & brand sharing ₹10K – ₹50K Religion & Personal Beliefs In his YouTube video “Meri Kahani” , released after hitting 100K subscribers, AB Cricinfo opened up about his struggles, but still chose not to reveal his name or religion. However, according to multiple online reports, he is believed to belong to a Punjabi Hindu family . Personal Interests & Values Beyond cricket, AB Cricinfo is vocal about social and political issues . He earned widespread respect when he refused to cover India vs Pakistan matches during the Asia Cup , as a tribute to the victims of the Pahalgam terror attack . The decision was widely appreciated and reinforced his image as someone who stands by his principles. Favourites Favourite Cricketers:  Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma Favourite Actor:  Unknown Favourite Actress:  Unknown Favourite Movie:  Unknown Achievements & Recognition From earning just ₹4,000 a month  to becoming one of India’s most recognised cricket YouTubers, AB Cricinfo’s journey proves one thing: Consistency + authenticity always win. He’s not just entertaining millions, he’s inspiring creators to stay real, speak boldly, and trust the process. AB Cricinfo is a popular Indian cricket YouTuber and social media influencer known for bold opinions, emotional delivery, and humorous trolling — especially of Pakistan cricket. What is AB Cricinfo’s real name? His real name has not been officially revealed. How did AB Cricinfo start his career? He worked as a telecaller, car salesman, and video editor at ABP News before launching his YouTube channel. What is AB Cricinfo’s monthly income? He earns approximately ₹4.5–₹15 lakh per month , depending on ads, sponsorships, and collaborations. Why does AB Cricinfo hide his identity? To keep the focus on content, maintain privacy, and speak freely without personal distractions.
